articles.summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Daktronics, Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
articles.title: Daktronics to Participate in the Craig-Hallum 23rd Annual Institutional Investor Conference on May 28th

articles.summary: Delivering a new game-day experience to Tar Heels fans at Kenan Stadium, Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, partnered with the University of North Carolina (UNC) in Chapel Hill to manufacture and install 11 LED displays totaling more than 10,000 square feet – roughly one square foot for every five seats in the stadium – and more than 14.7 million LEDs.
articles.title: UNC Improves Fan Experience with 11 Daktronics LED Displays

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, announced the 2026 High School Video Summit, a two‑day educational experience designed to help high school educators and student production teams strengthen their live event operations ahead of the upcoming season.
articles.title: Daktronics Announces 2026 High School Video Summit for Educators and Student-Led Live Event Production

articles.summary: Daktronics has expanded its international sales team with the hiring of Steffan Piolet to expand the company’s indoor and stadium projects in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Scandinavia and Eastern Europe.
articles.title: Daktronics Welcomes Steffan Piolet to European Sales Team

articles.summary: When Cavaliers baseball fans head to Davenport Field at Disharoon Park this season, they will be greeted by a new LED video display – top ten in size in college baseball – manufactured and installed by Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, in partnership with the University of Virginia (UVA).
articles.title: University of Virginia, Daktronics Brighten Davenport Field with Top Ten Largest Video Display in College Baseball

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, is highlighting the growth of Street Media Group (SMG), a 16‑person out‑of‑home (OOH) company leveraging Daktronics digital display technology to grow rapidly across multiple states.
articles.title: Daktronics Technology Fuels Street Media Group’s Rapid Multi-State Expansion
